details.self_contained: Yes, no external CDN except allowed Mermaid/Chart.js (not used)

issues.description: PDF file cannot be generated in this environment. No PDF rendering tool (wkhtmltopdf, headless Chrome, etc.) is available. The HTML file is complete and print-ready with proper @media print styles configured. PDF can be generated manually via browser print-to-PDF (Ctrl+P or Cmd+P in any modern browser, then print to PDF). All slide break logic is configured in CSS.

workaround: Open presentation.html in any browser and use browser's native print-to-PDF functionality. This produces a pixel-perfect PDF matching the screen layout. Alternatively, use a command-line tool like 'wkhtmltopdf presentation.html presentation.pdf' or Puppeteer/Playwright outside this environment.
